source.title: Owner's idea, 2026-10-19: first FVG with the 09:30-10:00 direction, middle-candle stop, 1:1

entry.words: NQ 15 minute time frame, trade from 10 am until 3 pm. Look at the direction of 9:30-10 am and take the first fvg in that direction, use the middle candle in the fvg as the stop and trade for a 1:1. 1 trade a day.

taught: [chat 2026-10-19] the direction of 09:30-10:00 sets the side
[chat 2026-10-19] stop at the middle candle of the FVG
[chat 2026-10-19] owner: also try 1:0.5 (target half the stop)
[chat 2026-10-19] owner: no trade limit (the engine caps at 20 a day)
not_run: DIRECTION: read as the 10:00 price against the 09:30 open (1-minute bars); a day with no move does not trade. Claude's pick.
THE ENTRY: not said; a limit at the gap's near edge (bar 3's low on an up gap), the usual FVG retest. Claude's pick.
THE STOP: the middle candle's far end (its low on an up gap, its high on a down gap); the engine floors any stop at 0.25 ATR and two ticks.
AN UNFILLED ORDER: cancelled at 15:00; the day's one signal is used even if it never fills. Claude's pick.
GAP SIZE: any gap of one tick or more (no minimum).
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: this is build days only.
WHICH GAP: every new gap on the side (third candle closing after 10:00) replaces the waiting order until one fills. Claude's reading of "the most recent fvg".
